title: Haaye Haaye Qasim
body:
Haaye Haaye Qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaidi bunker pabande rasan lashon say jo guzre ahle haram
Har bib apne pyaro say hoti thi vida karke maatam
Ek bibi binte Fatima binte hasan paamal badan qasim ki behan.
Kissi ek jaan say ruksat na hui-2
Tukdo mein jot ha bhai ka badan, kahbie is tukde par hai qasim kabhie us tukde par haye qasim.
Teri band gharib nuh nai bhulna-2
Tere qatl da manzar hai qasim.
<<MINI>>
Haye haye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhie sehra dekh kay rooti thi khabie ghash khake girjati thi 2
Paamaal hua tha bhai jahan. 2
Us khoon pay girke hai qasim
Haye haye
<<DIVIDER>>
Wich rasiyan day paaband hui nai behan garib da vas koi 2
Hunday hath aazad tay marjandi 2
Tera matam kar kar haye qasim
<<MINI>>
Haye haye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis shaan say tum dulha thay bane kis shaan say thi baaraat chali.2
Baithi rahi dulhan hujre mein. 2
Aaye na palat kar haye qasim.

Haye haye qasim.
<<DIVIDER>>
Farva nay kahan beta qasim kehdena daadi zehra say 2
Gurbat ki kamai tukdo mein 2
Dey di hai sajaa kay hai qasim

Haye haye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Sanu raaz na aayi karbobala Tu banj kafan main banj rida. 2
Tere qatl dey baad laena nay 2
Meri luth gai chadar hai qasim.

Haaye haaye qasim
<<DIVIDER>>
Har saath muharrum ko mehdi. teri yaad mein qasim uthti hai.2
Dulha dulha qasim dulha
Hota hai labon par haye qasim.
<<MINI>>
Haaye qasim
